admission.justification: A union merge that was trusted unchecked could land a catalog that holds a line twice, the line of a deleted file or two interleaved rows; without the union, every sync of an open leaf stops on the same lists and is resolved by hand.

applicability: Merges and stash applications of mcp/tests/test-evidence-lanes.toml and mcp/tests/evidence-lifecycle.toml in a worktree whose .gitattributes declares merge=union for both.
conditions: Git reads the attribute from the worktree in which the merge or the stash application runs.
The sentence about interleaved rows is the recovery the loaders give a file that does not parse.
exclusions: A merge in a worktree whose .gitattributes does not hold the two lines; the attribute does not apply there.
Every other merge Git performs for this repository.
statement: Git merges the two test catalogs by union, so two changes that add lines to the same list merge and reapply without a conflict, and a merge that interleaves rows is refused with the recovery sentence.
